summary: Four-panel ground cabin built in 1941 in Bridger-Teton NF's Sublette County, staffed only in high fire hazard, NHLR-registered 2022, wrapped during the 2025 Horse Fire.

facts.design: smaller four-panel ground cabin (not on a tower)

staffing.status: apparently staffed only in times of high fire hazard (NHLR); 1941 plan was to man it when the Cora weather station showed low humidity and high fire hazard

facts.agency: US Forest Service, Bridger-Teton National Forest

events.note: NHLR gives 1941; July 1941 newspaper items describe the cabin finished for the Forest Service
1941 plan: man the lookout when the Cora weather station showed low humidity and high fire hazard; NHLR says it was apparently staffed only in high fire hazard times
Registered May 10, 2022 as US 1570, WY 22; nominated by Brad Eells
Horse Fire burning nearby in July 2025; lookout reported still wrapped

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR gives 9,665 ft (2,946 m); firelookout.com gives 9642'. The record's elevation_m (2945.9) matches NHLR and is kept; the story reports the NHLR figure and notes the difference.

notes_for_editor: Build year (1941) and staffing are consistent across NHLR and the 1941 newspaper items as transcribed on Forest Lookouts; the original newspaper scans were not read. Current access, rental status and condition are not established beyond the July 2025 FFLA post. A June 2025 Pinedale Online / geolconsulting article on protecting the tower could not be read (SSL certificate errors from both fetch_text and WebFetch), so the wrap and fire details rest on the FFLA post alone. Elevation differs between NHLR (9,665 ft) and firelookout.com (9642'). Access is omitted because no level could be supported. No photos added.
